//For the x86 compilation target, the use of SIMD gather/scatter
// instructions can be much slower than using scalar loads. This
// includes a wide range of Intel hardware (in particular, server
// processors of the Broadwell, Skylake, Cascade Lake, and Ice
// Lake families released between 2015 and 2021). While the default
// is to aggressively use these instructions, this variable can
// be used to disable their use if deemed to give better performance.
